verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ዝ፡ ዘርእየት፡ ዓይንየ፡ ወዘሰምዐት፡ ዕዝንየ።
verses.translation: Behold, mine eye has seen these things, and mine ear has heard them.

translations.lxx: Behold, mine eye has seen these things, and mine ear has heard them.
translations.kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
translations.ron: De bună seamă, ochiul meu a văzut toate acestea, urechea mea le-a auzit şi le-a înţeles.

verses.geez: ወኣአምር፡ ዘከመ፡ ተአምሩ፡ እንትሙ፡ ወእምኔክሙሂ፡ ኢየዓብድ።
verses.translation: And I know all that ye too know; and I have not less understanding than you.

translations.lxx: And I know all that ye too know; and I have not less understanding than you.
translations.kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
translations.ron: Ceea ce ştiţi voi, ştiu şi eu şi nu sunt deloc mai prejos decât voi.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ አንሳ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እነግር፡ ወእትዋቅሥ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለእመ፡ ፈቀደ፡፡ 4፡ አንተስ፡ ዓቀብተ፡ ሥራይ፡ ዘዓመፃ፡ ወመናዝዛን፡ ለእኪት፡ ኵልክሙ።
verses.translation: Nevertheless I will speak to the Lord, and I will reason before him, if he will.

translations.lxx: Nevertheless I will speak to the Lord, and I will reason before him, if he will.
translations.kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
translations.ron: Dar eu vreau să vorbesc cu Cel Atotputernic, vreau să-mi apăr pricina înaintea lui Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ኢይረትዓኒ፡ አጽምአክሙ፡ እስመ፡ ጠፍአት፡ ጥበብ፡ እምኔክሙ።
verses.translation: But would that ye were silent, and it would be wisdom to you in the end.

translations.lxx: But would that ye were silent, and it would be wisdom to you in the end.
translations.kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
translations.ron: Ce bine ar fi fost dacă aţi fi tăcut! Câtă înţelepciune ar fi fost din partea voastră!

verses.geez: ስምዑኒ፡ ቅስተ፡ አፉየ፡ ወአጽምኡኒ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ከናፍርየ።
verses.translation: But hear ye the reasoning of my mouth, and attend to the judgment of my lips.

translations.lxx: But hear ye the reasoning of my mouth, and attend to the judgment of my lips.
translations.kjv: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi acum apărarea mea şi băgaţi de seamă la rostirea buzelor mele.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ አኮኑ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ትነብሩ፡ ወታየድሁ፡ ጕኅኩተ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ወትትገኃሡ፡ እምኔሁ፡ እስኩ፡ ለሊክሙ፡ ፍትሑ።
verses.translation: Do ye not speak before the Lord, and utter deceit before him?

translations.lxx: Do ye not speak before the Lord, and utter deceit before him?
translations.kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
translations.ron: Oare de dragul lui Dumnezeu spuneţi voi lucruri strâmbe şi spre apărarea Lui croiţi minciuni?

verses.geez: ሠናይኑ፡ እመ፡ የሐትቱክሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ትገብሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ተኃሥሡ።
verses.translation: Or will ye draw back? nay, do ye yourselves be judges.

translations.lxx: Or will ye draw back? nay, do ye yourselves be judges.
translations.kjv: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
translations.ron: Voiţi să ţineţi cu El şi să fiţi apărătorii Lui?

verses.geez: በምንትኑ፡ ታስማስልዎ፡ ከመትትዋቀሱ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለገጽለሰ፡ ታደልዉ፡ ወለፌ፡ ተኀብኡ፡ እምቅሜሁ።
verses.translation: For it were well if he would thoroughly search you: for though doing all things in your power ye should attach yourselves to him,

translations.lxx: For it were well if he would thoroughly search you: for though doing all things in your power ye should attach yourselves to him,
translations.kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
translations.ron: Şi dacă ar fi ca să vă cerceteze, ar fi bine de voi, sau vreţi să-L înşelaţi cum înşelaţi un om?

verses.geez: ቀዳሜሁ፡ አኮኑ፡ ኃይሉ፡ ያፈርሀክሙ፡ ወይመጽአክሙ፡ ግሩም፡ እምኀቤሁ።
verses.translation: he will not reprove you at all the less: but if moreover ye should secretly respect persons,

translations.lxx: he will not reprove you at all the less: but if moreover ye should secretly respect persons,
translations.kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
translations.ron: Desigur El vă va osândi dacă în ascuns vreţi să fiţi părtinitori cu El.

verses.geez: ዘለፋክሙኒ፡ ኃላፊ፡ ከመ፡ ሐመድ፡ ወሥጋክሙኒ፡ መሬት።
verses.translation: shall not his whirlpool sweep you round, and terror from him fall upon you?

translations.lxx: shall not his whirlpool sweep you round, and terror from him fall upon you?
translations.kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
translations.ron: Măreţia Lui oare nu vă înfricoşează şi groaza Lui nu va cădea oare peste voi?

verses.geez: ተጸመሙኒ፡ እንብብ፡ ወእስኀት፡ እምኅምዝ።
verses.translation: And your glorying shall prove in the end to you like ashes, and your body like a body of clay.

translations.lxx: And your glorying shall prove in the end to you like ashes, and your body like a body of clay.
translations.kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
translations.ron: Rostirile voastre au tăria cenuşei. Răspunsurile voastre se prefac în noroi.

verses.geez: ወአስተጋብኣ፡ ለሥጋየ፡ በስነንየ፡ ወአጠውቃ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ በእዴየ።
verses.translation: Be silent, that I may speak, and cease from mine anger,

translations.lxx: Be silent, that I may speak, and cease from mine anger,
translations.kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
translations.ron: Închideţi gura în faţa mea şi eu voi vorbi, orice ar fi să se întâmple.

verses.geez: ወእምዕዑብ፡ አትሜጠዋ፡ ለልብስየ፡ ወአመሰ፡ ኢተመጠውክዋ፡ በኃይል፡ እመ፡ እምኢተንሠአት፡ ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ እነግር፡ ወእትዋቀሥ፡ ቅድሜሁ።
verses.translation: while I may take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

translations.lxx: while I may take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.
translations.kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
translations.ron: Drept aceea îmi voi lua în dinţi carnea mea şi viaţa mea o pun în mâna mea.

verses.geez: ወዝንቱኒ፡ ይከውነኒ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይበውእ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ትምይንት።
verses.translation: Though the Mighty One should lay hand upon me, forasmuch as he has begun, verily I will speak, and plead before him.

translations.lxx: Though the Mighty One should lay hand upon me, forasmuch as he has begun, verily I will speak, and plead before him.
translations.kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
translations.ron: Dacă o fi să mă ucidă, nu voi tremura, dar voi descurca în faţa Sa firele pricinei mele,

verses.geez: ስንዑኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ ወአነ፡ እነግረክሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ታጸምኡኒ።
verses.translation: And this shall turn to me for salvation; for fraud shall have no entrance before him.

translations.lxx: And this shall turn to me for salvation; for fraud shall have no entrance before him.
translations.kjv: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
translations.ron: Şi chiar aceasta îmi va fi mie izbândă, fiindcă un nelegiuit nu se înfăţişează înaintea Lui.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አነ፡ ቀረብኩ፡ ኀበፍትሕየ፡ ወአእምር፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ ታስተርኢ፡ ጽድቅየ።
verses.translation: Hear, hear ye my words, for I will declare in your hearing.

translations.lxx: Hear, hear ye my words, for I will declare in your hearing.
translations.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi cu luare-aminte cuvintele mele şi ceea ce vă voi spune să vă rămână în urechi.

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘተዕፅረ፡ ከመ፡ እጸመም፡ ይእዜ፡ ወአረምም፡ እከውን፡ ከመ፡ ዓብድ፡ ወአትኃባእኑ፡ እምገጽከ።
verses.translation: Behold, I am near my judgment: I know that I shall appear evidently just.

translations.lxx: Behold, I am near my judgment: I know that I shall appear evidently just.
translations.kjv: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
translations.ron: Iată am pus la cale o judecată, şi ştiu că eu sunt cel ce am dreptate.

verses.geez: ወአእትት፡ እምኔየ፡ እዴክ፡ ወአያጥቀኒ፡ ግርማክ፡፡ 20፡ ትጼውዓኒ፡ ወአነ፡ አሰጠወከ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ተናገርከኒ፡ አነሂ፡ አወሥአከ።
verses.translation: For who is he that shall plead with me, that I should now be silent, and expire?

translations.lxx: For who is he that shall plead with me, that I should now be silent, and expire?
translations.kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
translations.ron: Are cineva ceva de spus împotriva mea? Atunci voi amuţi degrabă şi voi aştepta moartea.

verses.geez: ወሚመጠን፡ እማንቱ፡ ኃጣውእየ፡ ወአበሳየ፡ እርአየኒኬ፡ ምንት፡ እማንቱ።
verses.translation: Withhold thine hand from me: and let not thy fear terrify me.

translations.lxx: Withhold thine hand from me: and let not thy fear terrify me.
translations.kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
translations.ron: Depărtează mâna Ta de deasupră-mi şi nu mă mai tulbura cu groaza Ta.

verses.geez: ወለምት፡ ትሤውር፡ እምኔየ፡ ወትሬስየኒ፡ ጸላኢክ።
verses.translation: Then shalt thou call, and I will hearken to thee: or thou shalt speak, and I will give thee an answer.

translations.lxx: Then shalt thou call, and I will hearken to thee: or thou shalt speak, and I will give thee an answer.
translations.kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
translations.ron: Apoi cheamă-mă şi eu iţi voi răspunde, sau lasă-mă să vorbesc eu şi Tu să-mi dai răspuns.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ቈጽል፡ ዘይትነገፍ፡ እምነፋስ፡ ተሐፍሰኒ፡ ወከመ፡ ሣዕር፡ ዘይነሥአ፡ ነፋስ፡ ታሠርረኒ፡ ሣዕረኑ፡ ወብርሀ፡ ዘይየብስ፡ ትዴግን።
verses.translation: How many are my sins and my transgressions? teach me what they are.

translations.lxx: How many are my sins and my transgressions? teach me what they are.
translations.kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
translations.ron: Câte greşeli şi câte păcate am făcut? Dă-mi pe faţă călcarea mea de lege şi păcatul meu.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ጸሐፍከ፡ አከይየ፡ ሰዘላዕሌየ፡ ወዓቀብከ፡ ሊተ፡ ኃጢኤትየ፡ ዘንአስየ፡ ወዐቅነትከኒ፡ ወአቀምኮን፡ ውስተ፡ ዳኅዕ፡ ለአገርየ።
verses.translation: Wherefore hidest thou thyself from me, and deemest me thine enemy?

translations.lxx: Wherefore hidest thou thyself from me, and deemest me thine enemy?
translations.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
translations.ron: De ce ascunzi faţa Ta şi mă iei drept un duşman al Tău?

verses.geez: ወሤምከ፡ ሊኰ፡ ምግባርየ፡ ወሶበ፡ ቆመት፡ እግርየ፡ ኅደገኒ።
verses.translation: Wilt thou be startled at me, as at a leaf shaken by the wind? or wilt thou set thyself against me as against grass borne upon the breeze?

translations.lxx: Wilt thou be startled at me, as at a leaf shaken by the wind? or wilt thou set thyself against me as against grass borne upon the breeze?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
translations.ron: Vrei oare, să înspăimânţi o frunză pe care o bate vântul? Vrei să Te îndârjeşti împotriva unui pai uscat?
